Prompt 👇

Character name: 
Create a premium game-UI character ability sheet using the uploaded reference character, translated into a highly simplified geometric pictogram style.
LIKENESS INTEGRITY, HIGHEST PRIORITY
Every instance must remain unmistakably the exact uploaded character.
Preserve: exact head-to-body proportions, exact eye shape, spacing, size, and placement, exact silhouette and anatomy logic, original color palette and major color placement, defining clothing, accessories, footwear, and design traits.
Do not humanize. Do not modify facial structure. Do not add facial features. Do not redesign the anatomy. Do not turn the character into a generic game mascot.
GEOMETRIC CHARACTER LANGUAGE
Reduce the character into clean flat geometric shapes: circles, rounded rectangles, wedges, simplified curved blocks, bold silhouette shapes, minimal internal cutouts.
Use very few shapes per character.
Preserve recognizability through proportion, eyes, silhouette, color blocking, and defining traits rather than small details.
No realism. No 3D rendering. No texture. No painterly treatment.
GAME UI CONCEPT
Design the page like a premium character ability-selection interface from a stylish modern fighting game or action RPG.
Show 8 different ability icons or move states of the same character.
Possible actions: basic attack, defensive stance, dash, jump attack, charged attack, special ability, ultimate move, low-energy / recovery state.
Each pose must be dramatically different and instantly readable at small size.
No repeated pose logic.
ICON CARDS
Each ability appears inside its own UI card or tile.
Cards should use: rounded rectangular frames, restrained translucent panels, thin geometric borders, subtle layered depth, small accent bars, minimal corner details, circular or angular energy indicators.
The UI itself should feel sophisticated and restrained, not like a generic mobile-game menu.
CHARACTER ICON STYLE
The character inside each ability card is rendered as a flat geometric pictogram.
Use: solid color fills, simplified silhouette, very limited internal lines, sharp readable negative space, original character colors.
For action poses, subtle secondary graphic shapes may communicate movement: directional wedges, arcs, impact rings, speed lines, simplified energy geometry.
These elements must remain flat graphic symbols, not realistic VFX.
COLOR SYSTEM
Background: deep charcoal, graphite, muted navy, or near-black.
UI: slightly lighter translucent panels.
Character: original palette remains the strongest color information.
Ability accents: derive one or two complementary accent colors from the character’s existing palette.
Use saturation selectively. Avoid rainbow UI colors.
COMPOSITION
Wide horizontal game-interface composition.
Main character portrait or large neutral pictogram appears on one side.
The remaining space contains the ability tiles arranged in a clean asymmetric grid.
Allow different card sizes to create hierarchy: one large ultimate ability card, several medium ability cards, smaller passive or status cards.
Avoid perfect spreadsheet symmetry.
The layout should feel designed, modular, and playable.
TYPOGRAPHY
Minimal fictional UI labels are allowed only if necessary.
Prefer: tiny abstract symbols, short numerical indicators, simple level bars, iconography.
Avoid long text blocks.
If text appears, keep it subtle and secondary to the character imagery.
LIGHTING / VISUAL DEPTH
The character pictograms remain completely flat.
Create depth only through the interface: subtle panel transparency, faint inner shadows, restrained edge glow, soft background gradient, very gentle glass-like layering.
No realistic lighting on the character. No dramatic shadows inside pictograms.
UI DETAILS
Optional interface elements: health or energy meter, circular cooldown indicators, small passive ability slots, character-level indicator, selection highlight around one ability, subtle targeting brackets, tiny geometric status icons.
Everything should share one coherent visual system.
FINAL INTENT
The result should look like an official character ability screen from a premium stylized video game, built around a geometric pictogram translation of the exact uploaded character.
Clean enough to function as real UI. Graphic enough to feel iconic. Distinct enough that every ability is readable instantly.
No generic fantasy UI. No clutter. No photorealism. No 3D character rendering. No gradients inside the character. No excessive glow. No random interface text. No character redesign.

提示词 👇

角色名称：
使用上传的参考角色，制作一张高端游戏 UI 角色能力面板，并将其转换为高度简化的几何象形符号风格。
相似度还原，最高优先级
每一个实例都必须毫无疑义地保持为上传的那个角色。
保留：精确的头身比例，精确的眼睛形状、间距、大小与位置，精确的轮廓与解剖逻辑，原有配色以及主要色彩的分布，标志性服装、配饰、鞋履与设计特征。
不要拟人化。不要修改面部结构。不要添加面部特征。不要重新设计解剖结构。不要把角色变成通用的游戏吉祥物。
几何角色语言
将角色还原为干净的扁平几何形状：圆形、圆角矩形、楔形、简化的弧形块面、大胆的剪影形状、极少量的内部镂空。
每个角色使用非常少的形状。
通过比例、眼睛、剪影、色块分布和标志性特征来保持可识别性，而不是依靠细节。
不要写实。不要 3D 渲染。不要纹理。不要绘画式处理。
游戏 UI 概念
将页面设计成一款 stylish 现代格斗游戏或动作 RPG 中的高端角色能力选择界面。
展示同一角色的 8 个不同能力图标或动作状态。
可用的动作：基础攻击、防御姿态、冲刺、跳跃攻击、蓄力攻击、特殊能力、终极技、低能量 / 恢复状态。
每个姿势必须差异显著，并且在很小的尺寸下也能瞬间读懂。
不要重复相同的姿势逻辑。
图标卡片
每个能力都出现在自己的 UI 卡片或图块中。
卡片应使用：圆角矩形边框、克制的半透明面板、纤细的几何描边、细微的层次深度、小型强调色条、极简的角落细节、圆形或棱角分明的能量指示器。
UI 本身应显得精致而克制，而不是像通用的手游菜单。
角色图标风格
每张能力卡片中的角色都以扁平几何象形符号呈现。
使用：纯色填充、简化的剪影、非常有限的内部线条、清晰锐利的负空间、角色原有配色。
对于动作姿势，可用细微的次级图形元素来传达运动感：方向性楔形、弧线、冲击环、速度线、简化的能量几何图形。
这些元素必须保持为扁平图形符号，而不是写实的视觉特效。
配色系统
背景：深炭灰、石墨灰、低饱和藏青或近黑色。
UI：略浅的半透明面板。
角色：原有配色仍然是画面中最强的色彩信息。
能力强调色：从角色现有配色中提取一到两个互补的强调色。
有选择地使用饱和度。避免彩虹般的 UI 配色。
构图
横向宽幅的游戏界面构图。
主角色立绘或大型中性象形符号位于一侧。
其余空间放置能力图块，排列成干净的不对称网格。
允许不同卡片尺寸来建立层级：一张大型终极技能卡片，若干张中型能力卡片，以及较小的被动或状态卡片。
避免完全如电子表格般的对称。
整体布局应显得经过设计、模块化且像可玩的界面。
排版
仅在必要时允许使用极简的虚构 UI 标签。
优先使用：微小的抽象符号、简短数值指示、简单的等级条、图标化元素。
避免大段文字。
如果出现文字，应保持低调，次于角色图像。
光照 / 视觉深度
角色象形符号保持完全扁平。
仅通过界面来营造深度：细微的面板透明度、淡淡的内阴影、克制的边缘辉光、柔和的背景渐变、非常轻柔的玻璃质感叠层。
角色上不要有写实光照。象形符号内部不要有强烈阴影。
UI 细节
可选的界面元素：生命值或能量槽、圆形冷却指示器、小型被动技能槽、角色等级指示器、围绕某一个能力的高亮选中框、细微的瞄准括号、微小的几何状态图标。
所有元素应共享同一套连贯的视觉系统。
最终意图
最终效果应看起来像一款高端风格化电子游戏中的官方角色能力界面，核心是对上传角色所做的几何象形符号转译。
干净到足以充当真实 UI。图形化到足以具有标志性。差异化到每个能力都能被瞬间读懂。
不要通用奇幻 UI。不要杂乱。不要照片级写实。不要 3D 角色渲染。角色内部不要渐变。不要过度辉光。不要随意的界面文字。不要重新设计角色。

1. UNIQUE VISUAL IDENTITY

Transform the destination into a bold geometric landscape using simplified architectural forms, angular mountains, overlapping shapes, dramatic silhouettes and carefully composed negative space.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
The exact same clearly adult female character appears in all nine panels. Preserve identical facial identity, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, accessories, species traits, and clothing throughout the entire grid. Do not create nine different characters.

A modest, lived-in domestic kitchen. The character is sitting at or leaning against the same kitchen table in every panel. Include ordinary household details such as a ceramic mug, breakfast plate, fruit bowl, bottle, napkins, utensils, food packaging, smartphone, or slightly disorganized kitchen objects.

OUTFIT:
Casual at-home clothing appropriate to the character: oversized T-shirt, tank top, loose hoodie, comfortable shorts, pajama pants, casual jeans, or similarly relaxed domestic wear. Keep the exact same outfit across all nine panels.

Three-quarter portrait angle in every panel, approximately waist-up or mid-torso-up. Natural variation in head tilt, shoulder angle, hand placement, and camera distance, while preserving a coherent photo-session feeling.

She is visibly irritated in every panel: grumpy, annoyed, tired, impatient, unimpressed, mildly hostile, or clearly wishing the photographer would leave her alone. Furrowed brows, narrowed eyes, pursed lips, deadpan glare, annoyed side-eye, restrained scowl. Absolutely no cheerful smiling.

Panel 1 — right-hand middle finger raised toward the viewer.
Panel 2 — left-hand middle finger held close to the camera.
Panel 3 — both middle fingers raised simultaneously.
Panel 4 — classic bras d’honneur / forearm jerk gesture, one fist raised while the opposite hand strikes or grips the bent forearm.
Panel 5 — insulting inward-facing V-sign, palm facing toward herself.
Panel 6 — dismissive chin-flick gesture, fingers brushing outward from beneath the chin.
Panel 7 — provocative fig gesture, thumb deliberately protruding between index and middle fingers.
Panel 8 — sarcastic downward-pointing thumb combined with an irritated dismissive hand motion.
Panel 9 — one hand pointing directly toward the viewer while the other hand raises a middle finger, creating an aggressive final-panel pose.

Every gesture must be clearly readable and visually different. Hands must remain completely visible inside the panel boundaries.

High-quality contemporary anime illustration with expressive adult facial anatomy, clean linework, sophisticated cel shading, detailed hair, natural hands, subtle fabric folds, believable domestic background perspective, and restrained cinematic lighting. LAYOUT LOCK:
One single finished image containing exactly nine rectangular panels.
3 columns × 3 rows.
Consistent panel dimensions.
Visible decorative borders.
No overlapping panels.
No missing cells.
No extra panels.
No text, captions, speech bubbles, numbering, logos, or watermarks.

同一个明确成年的女性角色出现在全部九个面板中。在整个网格中保持完全一致的面部特征、发型、发色、眼睛颜色、身体比例、配饰、物种特征与服装。不要创作出九个不同的角色。

面板 9 —— 一只手直接指向观众，另一只手竖起中指，形成收尾的挑衅姿势。

一个朴素、有人生活痕迹的家用厨房。在每个面板中，该角色都坐在同一张厨房餐桌旁或倚靠着它。加入日常家居细节，例如陶瓷马克杯、早餐餐盘、水果碗、瓶子、餐巾、餐具、食品包装、智能手机，或略微杂乱的厨房物件。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create one 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5. Continuous chronological action in one location, with coherent screen direction and motivated cuts. Dim downtown dusk, a full moon above the rooftops, and the neon-lit GAS SAL gas station. Keep residual twilight in the sky. Begin with quiet horror tension; from the rescue onward, use Hollywood action-movie camerawork every second. Time ranges describe action timing, not mandatory cuts. Use restrained motion blur, readable silhouettes and grounded physical contact.

REFERENCE LOCK

Image 1 = rescuer before transformation, approximately 1.88 meters tall. Use the main standing views and face close-ups of the current Image 1. Match his exact face, athletic build, very short textured hair with faded sides and a shaved side line, defined hairline, shaped mustache and short beard. He wears the dark sunglasses shown in the main face views. Match the deep-navy double-breasted suit with gold buttons, matching waistcoat, dark-navy shirt, gold paisley tie and matching pocket square, gold lapel ornament, polished very dark-brown cap-toe lace-up Oxford shoes, gold watch and rings. Preserve the navy fabric color under changing light. His sunglasses stay in place until the closing helmet covers his face. Keep this appearance consistent before the transformation. He is empty-handed and is a separate person from the six men.

Image 2 = the same rescuer after transformation. Use the Image 2 design, scaled uniformly to approximately 4.5 meters tall, overriding its printed height. Match the angular black horned helmet and pointed side fins, chipped white ceramic armor over a black mechanical frame, red luminous seams and red cross-shaped chest detailing, deep-red tattered cape, oversized jagged black greatsword with a red glowing edge, and one segmented spiked mechanical tail with red-lit joints. The tail remains attached to his lower back and articulates as a continuous mechanical structure. The greatsword and integrated tail are his only weapons.

Image 3 = all six subordinate werewolves, each 3.2 meters tall, sharing this exact fur pattern, ivory bone claws, armor and proportions.

Image 4 = one separate boss werewolf, exactly 8 meters tall, overriding the reference sheet's height. Match its red cape, twin wolf-head shoulder ornaments and claws. It is clearly larger than the knight.

Image 5 = the rescuer's hypercar: match the main black carbon-fiber design, orange accents and silhouette. It remains a car throughout.

Image 6 = the station's building, canopy, pumps and neon sign, recreated at dusk.

Image 7 = the woman, approximately 1.70 meters tall. Lock her exact face, facial proportions, tousled blonde bob, makeup, body proportions, full-length cream faux-fur coat, gold dress, black patent stiletto boots and jewelry across every appearance. Use this image for appearance only; omit handheld props shown in its pose panels.

Use references only for subject appearance and architecture. Keep sheet grids, labels, diagrams, printed text and studio backdrops outside the film. Keep knight and werewolf designs completely separate. The knight's segmented mechanical tail belongs only to him. Both the knight and boss wear red capes; distinguish them through their exact head shapes, armor, proportions and scale. Maintain cumulative damage to vehicles, glass and the station.

CAST AND CONTINUITY

The woman is an adult white woman in her late twenties, always matching Image 7. She has the same tousled blonde bob, smoky eye makeup and red lipstick. She wears the full-length oversized cream faux-fur coat, shimmering gold slip dress, black patent knee-high boots with pointed toes and stiletto heels, large gold hoop earrings, layered gold bracelets, rings, and black choker with a metal chain and pendant. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit and accessories consistent from the opening through the ending. The coat remains worn on both shoulders throughout. Her handheld objects are the fuel nozzle while refueling and the detached heel after the fall. Frame her face, hands and whole-body movement, with one brief functional boot-heel insert.

Six adult men have neck and arm tattoos and gold chains. Five remain expressionless; only their leader briefly gives an intimidating grin. During their human appearance, all six stay in their established positions without approaching or touching her. The leader is already across her car from her, leaning on its roof.

Human-to-werewolf changes happen inside swirling black sand clouds: six enlarged silhouettes form, then six werewolves emerge.

All defeated werewolves, including the boss, dissolve into dark sand. Show each decisive contact before dissolution.

Enemy continuity: six subordinates become five after the car impact, three after the paired sword strike, two after the storefront impact, one after the trailer sword strike, and zero after the tail impact. The boss appears separately at 19s. Defeated opponents remain gone.

The woman's car, the hypercar and the parked trailer are distinct vehicles. After rescue, she follows the streetward escape route to the far sidewalk. Staff evacuate before the storefront fight; the station is empty before the fire and final explosion.

TIMELINE

00-01s
Tight close-up of the Image 7 woman's exact face and blonde bob as she refuels. In her car window behind her reflection, exactly six blurred human silhouettes stand motionless. Neon crackle, distant city ambience and the fuel nozzle are audible.

01-02s
She turns. A single rack focus brings the leader into focus across the car: his tattooed hand rests on the roof as he leans and grins. Behind him, the five expressionless men look up at the full moon together. At 1.5s all sound stops; his grin disappears and he slowly raises his gaze toward the moon.

02-03s
The neon briefly blacks out, then relights the same space. Within six swirling black sand clouds, the men's silhouettes expand into nonhuman shapes. Cut to the same Image 7 face. At exactly 2.5s her sharp, nonverbal scream and a low creature growl break the silence together. The scream must begin before 3s.

03-04s
Wide shot: all six fully formed werewolves raise their heads and howl at the full moon in unison. Their sound pressure ripples the air. The GAS SAL neon tubes begin bursting in sequence, scattering sparks.

04-05s
Continue the wide shot. The pressure reaches the surrounding cars: windows shatter and security alarms erupt together. The woman releases the nozzle and starts running toward the street.

05-06s
Brief ground-level close-up of the same black patent boots from Image 7. At 5s one stiletto heel snaps with a sharp crack. Her balance gives way; she falls onto the asphalt and catches herself with both hands.

06-07s
Low medium-wide: seated on the pavement, she picks up the detached heel and pushes herself backward, unable to run. In the background, staff rush out of the shop and flee down the street. An approaching engine begins roaring offscreen.

07-08s
Hold the spatial relationship: she retreats seated in the foreground while the six werewolves advance behind her, crushing parked cars underfoot. The offscreen engine rapidly grows louder.

08-09s
LOCKED LOW-ANGLE WIDE. The leading werewolf launches low toward the woman. The hypercar enters in a controlled sideways drift, crossing the leap's path between her and the attacker. Keep the woman, the car's door-side flank and the airborne werewolf visible together.

09-10s
HOLD THE EXACT SAME SHOT WITHOUT A CUT OR WHIP-PAN. The hypercar's broad door-side flank directly strikes the airborne werewolf's side with unmistakable physical contact. The impact abruptly redirects the creature away from the woman. It flies outward, then disintegrates into black sand. Tire smoke stays low and the contact remains visible. The car stops as a barrier; five werewolves remain.

10-11s
Medium-wide with both people visible: the rescuer steps out, unmistakably matching the current Image 1. Clearly show his reference face with the same dark sunglasses, very short textured haircut, trimmed facial hair, deep-navy double-breasted suit with gold buttons, gold paisley tie and dark-brown Oxford shoes. His sunglasses remain on as he gives the Image 7 woman a silent chin gesture toward the street. Her reference face, blonde bob, coat and boots remain recognizable. She rises with the detached heel in her hand and begins limping away along that route.

11-12s
Restrained side tracking: the rescuer walks toward the five remaining werewolves through a low spiral of black sand. With each step, the black mechanical frame expands and white ceramic armor plates unfold and lock into place. Red seams illuminate as his height and stride increase. Keep his reference face and sunglasses consistent while the armor deploys. Segmented tail sections deploy from his lower back. The woman continues retreating in the background.

12-13s
Continue the same walking transformation. The full 4.5-meter Image 2 knight emerges from the clearing sand. His angular horned helmet closes over his face and sunglasses, the deep-red tattered cape unfurls, and the attached mechanical tail arches behind him. On the final enlarged step, he draws the jagged black-and-red greatsword from his back. Keep the blade and tail on separate, readable paths. The hypercar remains parked in its original vehicle form.

13-14s
Stable side-on wide: the five werewolves attack from different directions. The knight begins one powerful horizontal sword sweep toward the nearest pair. Their bodies, the blade and the approach paths remain readable.

14-15s
Hold the view through the sweep. The blade visibly contacts the first wolf and then the second in the same continuous stroke. Both dissolve separately into dark sand after contact. Three subordinate werewolves remain.

15-16s
A short lateral move follows the knight driving the third wolf directly into the evacuated shop's glass wall. Show the collision, the wall shattering outward, and that wolf collapsing into black sand. Two remain, now positioned on the parked trailer.

16-17s
Stable wide: the final two wolves leap from the empty trailer. The knight begins a rising sword stroke that visibly splits the trailer's side and roof along the blade's path.

17-18s
Continue the same sword action into one airborne wolf. The greatsword makes clear contact and follows through; that wolf dissolves into black sand. The last subordinate remains visibly airborne on the opposite side.

18-19s
In the same readable wide, the knight's attached segmented mechanical tail coils around the final wolf's torso. The tail flexes downward and slams the wolf into the asphalt. Keep the tail's connection to the knight, its curved path and the ground impact visible. After contact, the wolf collapses into black sand. All six subordinates are now gone.

19-20s
A massive roar announces the boss. Ground-level wide: the 8-meter boss drops into the forecourt and lands on an empty car, crushing it. Include the 4.5-meter knight in the same shot, standing on the same pavement at comparable distance from the camera.

20-21s
Hold both full bodies from feet to head in a low-angle two-shot. The knight's helmet reaches only the boss's lower chest. Ordinary cars reinforce their scale. Keep the knight's angular horned helmet, white-and-black armor and segmented tail distinct from the boss's wolf head, fur and twin wolf-head shoulder ornaments. Their red capes belong to separate, clearly readable silhouettes.

21-22s
Wide two-shot: the boss opens its mouth and projects a forceful stream of fire. The knight braces the broad flat of his greatsword and draws his deep-red cape behind it to withstand the blast. His attached tail curls behind him for balance.

22-23s
Maintain the two-shot. Deflected fire spreads to the fuel pumps and canopy. The knight holds his position behind the sword and cape while the larger boss keeps pressing forward.

23-24s
Steady side-on wide: the boss's claws collide directly with the knight's greatsword. Clearly show claws meeting metal; compact sparks mark the contact without covering it.

24-25s
Continue the same clash. The boss overpowers the knight and pushes him backward. His planted boots carve two parallel grooves in the asphalt. Keep both opponents together in frame.

25-26s
Stable three-quarter wide begins an uninterrupted finishing move. The knight rotates the greatsword, redirects the boss's claws downward and steps inside its reach. Briefly lower the sound immediately before the counterstrike.

26-27s
HOLD THIS VIEW THROUGH CONTACT AND FOLLOW-THROUGH. The knight delivers one decisive diagonal sword cut across the boss's armored torso. Clearly show the blade making contact and completing its full arc beyond the boss. Only after the blade clears does the boss collapse into black sand, completing its fall by 27s. The contact stays visible, with sparse sparks and sand appearing afterward.

27-28s
Wide hero composition: the fully evacuated station erupts in a massive explosion behind the knight. Fire engulfs the damaged canopy and shop; the knight stands as a clear silhouette against the flames, with the greatsword lowered, the deep-red cape moving in the blast and the segmented tail arched behind him.

28-29s
Show the same Image 7 woman on the far sidewalk, well away from the station. Her exact face and blonde bob are recognizable; her long cream coat, gold dress, black boots and jewelry remain consistent. She holds the detached heel visibly in her hand and looks back toward the knight and the burning station.

29-30s
The camera rises from her position and tilts above the rooftops to the full moon. Firelight flickers below; the explosion's rumble decays. End on the moon.

AUDIO

Sound effects and environmental sound only. No BGM, dialogue or narration. The woman's scream and creature calls are nonverbal.

00-1.5s: neon electrical crackle, distant city ambience and fuel-nozzle sounds.
1.5-2.5s: absolute silence, including ambience and all action sounds.
2.5s: synchronize the woman's scream with the low growl.
03-05s: layered howls, sequential neon pops, shattering windows and overlapping car alarms.
At 5s: a distinct heel-breaking crack.
06-08s: offscreen engine roar approaching quickly.
After 08s: tire squeal, solid collision impacts, footsteps, armor deployment, sword contact, articulated tail movement and falling sand; then the boss's roar and forceful fire jet.

Briefly dip the mix just before the final sword contact, restore it sharply for the strike, then deliver the separate station explosion at 27s with a deep physical impact.

FINAL CONSTRAINTS

Keep the car impact at 08-10s and finishing strike at 25-27s uninterrupted and sharply legible. Use minimal motion blur and clear cause-and-effect action; effects follow contact. Maintain exact identities, equipment, enemy counts and scale. Preserve the rescuer's Image 1 face, dark sunglasses, navy suit and dark-brown shoes through the car exit and the start of his transformation. Keep the woman's Image 7 appearance consistent at the opening, fall, rescue and final reaction.

No guns or additional weapons. No vehicle transformation. No subtitles, captions, title cards, added logos, watermarks or graphic overlays. The GAS SAL name exists only as physical neon tubing within the location.

Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Process each photo separately. Never combine photos into a collage, grid, split-screen, or multi-photo composition.

FORMAT

Strict 3:4 vertical composition, horizontally divided into two exactly equal 50/50 sections. Top 50% = original photography; bottom 50% = flat editorial illustration. Keep the overall design premium, clean, art-directed, visually balanced, and rich in negative space.

TOP 50% - ORIGINAL PHOT

Treat the uploaded photo as the single source of truth. Preserve the original subject, identity, facial features, body proportions, pose, expression, clothing, objects, environment, composition, colors, spatial relationships, lighting, shadows, depth, and photographic texture. Do not redesign, replace, beautify, distort, stretch, duplicate, or reinterpret the subject. Only subtle professional color grading is allowed, with the feel of an independent art magazine, premium travel editorial, or exhibition photograph. If more space is needed, naturally extend the existing background without altering the subject.

BOTTOM 50% - FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION

Reinterpret the same photograph as a playful, slightly awkward Korean-inspired flat editorial illustration. Identify and preserve the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, action, key relationships, and narrative of the original scene. Simplify them into rounded, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes with clean solid fills and rough, imperfect black hand-drawn outlines featuring subtle wobble, uneven thickness, broken edges, and imperfect contours. Remove photorealistic lighting, shadows, perspective, and material textures. Avoid conventional cartoon or photorealistic styles. Aim for a contemporary Korean children's book, independent magazine graphic, or playful editorial artwork.

COMPOSITION

Keep one dominant focal point with secondary objects used only as accents. Create relaxed visual rhythm through varied scale, slight misalignment, overlaps, partial cropping, irregular spacing, and subtle asymmetry. Allow some shapes to extend beyond or overlap the composition. Use bold color blocks and generous negative space. Preserve key visual relationships without reproducing every detail. The illustration should feel designed, relaxed, and intentionally imperfect, never mechanically traced or cluttered.

COLOR

Extract the photograph's most distinctive colors and reinterpret them as a limited palette of high-purity, high-saturation flat colors. Use bold, clean color blocks and bright youthful contrasts. No gradients, realistic shadows, muddy gray tones, glossy effects, complex blending, or excessive texture. The palette should feel cheerful, energetic, childlike, warm, and visually confident.

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL TEXT

Generate English text inspired by the photo's theme, action, emotion, atmosphere, or story. Integrate typography naturally into the

illustration.

MAIN TITLE: 2-4 English words, placed near the upper illustration area. Use playful, slightly handwritten, imperfect lettering; irregular alignment or capitalization is allowed.

SUBTAGLINE: One short, restrained English phrase below the title.

LOCATION / YEAR: Small editorial line in the lower-middle area. Use a verified location/year when known; otherwise use the subject, activity, event, or travel theme. Never invent a location.

POETIC MICRO-CAPTION: A short 1-2 line poetic or playful phrase, placed naturally within negative space, beside a color block, along

an edge, or on the visual axis.

SERIES NUMBER: Small, subtle editorial numbering such as "No.01" in a corner.

Typography may follow subject contours, align with color blocks, occupy negative space, overlap shapes slightly, rotate subtly, or use irregular spacing/cropping. Readability must remain strong. Title can be expressive; supporting text should stay clean and restrained.

Art DIRECTION

Combine real travel photography x playful flat illustration x premium editorial design x Korean graphic sensibility x travel diary aesthetics. The result should feel bright, youthful, cheerful, warm, playful, slightly quirky, sophisticated, and collectible-like a limited-edition travel art print or contemporary illustrated travel diary, not a generic tourist poster.

STRICT RESTRICTIONS

One photo = one independent poster. Never combine photos. Never invent a different scene, replace the subject, alter identity or pose, or introduce unrelated objects. Keep the bottom illustration clearly derived from the same photo shown above. No photorealistic illustration, excessive gradients, shadows, 3D/glossy effects, visual clutter, or overcrowding. The top and bottom must feel like two connected interpretations of the same travel moment.

格式

严格的 3:4 竖版构图，水平划分为恰好相等的两部分，各占 50%。上半部分 50% = 原始摄影；下半部分 50% = 平面编辑插画。整体设计保持高端、干净、有艺术指导感、视觉平衡，并留有丰富的负空间。

上半部分 50% — 原始照片

将上传的照片视为唯一真实来源。保留原始主体、身份、面部特征、身体比例、姿势、表情、服装、物体、环境、构图、色彩、空间关系、光线、阴影、景深与摄影质感。不得重新设计、替换、美化、扭曲、拉伸、复制或重新诠释主体。只允许细微的专业调色，呈现独立艺术杂志、高端旅行编辑或展览摄影的感觉。如需更多空间，自然延展现有背景，而不改动主体。

下半部分 50% — 平面编辑插画

将同一张照片重新诠释为俏皮、略带笨拙感的韩式平面编辑插画。识别并保留原始场景中最具辨识度的主体、剪影、姿势、动作、关键关系与叙事。将它们简化为圆润、略微夸张的几何形状，搭配干净的纯色填充与粗糙、不完美的黑色手绘轮廓，轮廓需有细微抖动、粗细不均、断裂边缘与不规则走向。去除照片写实的光影、透视与材质质感。避免常规卡通或照片写实风格。目标是当代韩国童书、独立杂志图形或俏皮的编辑艺术作品。

构图

保持一个主导的视觉焦点，次要物体仅作为点缀。通过变化的尺度、轻微错位、重叠、部分裁切、不规则间距与微妙的不对称，营造放松的视觉节奏。允许部分形状延伸超出或重叠于构图之外。使用大胆的色块与充裕的负空间。保留关键视觉关系，但无需复现每一个细节。插画应显得经过设计、放松且有意的不完美，绝不能像机械描摹或显得杂乱。

Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Process each photo separately. Never combine photos into a collage, grid, split-screen, or multi-photo composition.

FORMAT

Strict 3:4 vertical composition, horizontally divided into two exactly equal 50/50 sections. Top 50% = original photography; bottom 50% = flat editorial illustration. Keep the overall design premium, clean, art-directed, visually balanced, and rich in negative space.

TOP 50% - ORIGINAL PHOT

Treat the uploaded photo as the single source of truth. Preserve the original subject, identity, facial features, body proportions, pose, expression, clothing, objects, environment, composition, colors, spatial relationships, lighting, shadows, depth, and photographic texture. Do not redesign, replace, beautify, distort, stretch, duplicate, or reinterpret the subject. Only subtle professional color grading is allowed, with the feel of an independent art magazine, premium travel editorial, or exhibition photograph. If more space is needed, naturally extend the existing background without altering the subject.

BOTTOM 50% - FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION

Reinterpret the same photograph as a playful, slightly awkward Korean-inspired flat editorial illustration. Identify and preserve the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, action, key relationships, and narrative of the original scene. Simplify them into rounded, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes with clean solid fills and rough, imperfect black hand-drawn outlines featuring subtle wobble, uneven thickness, broken edges, and imperfect contours. Remove photorealistic lighting, shadows, perspective, and material textures. Avoid conventional cartoon or photorealistic styles. Aim for a contemporary Korean children's book, independent magazine graphic, or playful editorial artwork.

COMPOSITION

Keep one dominant focal point with secondary objects used only as accents. Create relaxed visual rhythm through varied scale, slight misalignment, overlaps, partial cropping, irregular spacing, and subtle asymmetry. Allow some shapes to extend beyond or overlap the composition. Use bold color blocks and generous negative space. Preserve key visual relationships without reproducing every detail. The illustration should feel designed, relaxed, and intentionally imperfect, never mechanically traced or cluttered.

COLOR

Extract the photograph's most distinctive colors and reinterpret them as a limited palette of high-purity, high-saturation flat colors. Use bold, clean color blocks and bright youthful contrasts. No gradients, realistic shadows, muddy gray tones, glossy effects, complex blending, or excessive texture. The palette should feel cheerful, energetic, childlike, warm, and visually confident.

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL TEXT

Generate English text inspired by the photo's theme, action, emotion, atmosphere, or story. Integrate typography naturally into the

illustration.

MAIN TITLE: 2-4 English words, placed near the upper illustration area. Use playful, slightly handwritten, imperfect lettering; irregular alignment or capitalization is allowed.

SUBTAGLINE: One short, restrained English phrase below the title.

LOCATION / YEAR: Small editorial line in the lower-middle area. Use a verified location/year when known; otherwise use the subject, activity, event, or travel theme. Never invent a location.

POETIC MICRO-CAPTION: A short 1-2 line poetic or playful phrase, placed naturally within negative space, beside a color block, along

an edge, or on the visual axis.

SERIES NUMBER: Small, subtle editorial numbering such as "No.01" in a corner.

One photo = one independent poster. Never combine photos. Never invent a different scene, replace the subject, alter identity or pose, or introduce unrelated objects. Keep the bottom illustration clearly derived from the same photo shown above. No photorealistic illustration, excessive gradients, shadows, 3D/glossy effects, visual clutter, or overcrowding. The top and bottom must feel like two connected interpretations of the same travel moment.

上半部分 —— 真实世界

以真实目的地作为主要视觉参考。

创作一张令人屏息的、以写实手法呈现的 [DESTINATION] 旅行照片。
保留其可辨识的建筑、景观、地标与地理特征。
捕捉优美的自然光线、真实的色彩与空气透视的纵深感。
在适当之处加入一些微妙的人物元素、船只、街道或当地细节。
保持构图具有电影感、干净且极具沉浸感。

这一部分应让人感觉像是在一段美好旅程中拍摄的照片。

中部 —— 编辑感过渡区

在摄影与插画之间创造优雅的过渡。

用精美、考究的字体排印目的地名称。
以小号大写字母标注国家名称。
加入一句简短而富有诗意的旅行灵感标语。
使用精致的手绘装饰元素、微小的植物细节或极简的地点徽章。
保持大量留白与精致的编辑排版。

下半部分 —— 被重新想象为艺术的世界

将同一目的地转化为一幅美丽的极简手绘插画。

重现上方照片中可辨识的地标或景色。
使用细腻的水彩晕染、有表现力的水粉笔触与微妙的墨线轮廓。
将建筑与环境简化为优雅的艺术构图。
保留该目的地标志性的色彩、形状与独特特征。
加入一些 charming 的细节，例如小船、盛开的花枝、小小的人物、飞鸟或当地元素。
使用柔和的粉彩色调、低饱和色彩，并精心点缀少量明快亮色。
让部分水彩肌理与绘制的边缘自然地淡出至白色背景。

下半部分的插画必须是对上方所示同一地点的艺术诠释，而非毫不相关的场景。

高端插画旅行杂志的视觉风格。
当代极简编辑设计。
摄影与纯艺术之间的美感平衡。
细腻的水彩与混合媒介肌理。
考究的字体排印与大量负空间。
柔和、和谐的色彩体系。
优雅、干净且具收藏价值的海报外观。

竖版 4:5 海报。

下半部分：约 50% 为极简水彩插画。
两个世界之间有微妙而优雅的过渡。
目的地名称清晰可见且排印精美。
无创作者水印、无多余文字、无杂乱元素。

国家：[COUNTRY]
